record_title: Exact triangle formula for Pach--Tardos roundness and sharp fatness calibration
limitations: The formulas are triangle-specific; no improvement is claimed for arbitrary convex bodies or the equal-area partition constant. The fatness radius is the smallest-containing-disk radius, which differs from the three-point circumcircle radius for obtuse triangles. The motivating invariant is extremely recent, so unindexed parallel work remains possible.
